name: my-daily-habits-tracker
description: A dark-mode, mobile-first web application & PWA designed for high performance and daily discipline across three essential domains: 1. **Lifestyle**: Daily habits checklist with expandable month calendar & completion metrics. 2. **Trading**: Trade execution logger, journal entries, lot-size & risk calculator, and performance summary. 3. **Gym**: Workout notepad for sets, reps, and exercise logs with date-based filtering.
